subject: Offer initiation: tenant-claim mismatch & SKU stewarding
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Azure Marketplace Onboarding <mp-onboarding@microsoft.com>; Contoso Partner - Alex M. <alex.m@contoso.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Offer initiation: tenant-claim mismatch & SKU stewarding

Hi Anita / Marketplace team,

We're kicking off the Contoso offer and ran into two items that look like gating checks on your end. Quick summary and asks below — would appreciate a short confirmation so we can move the manifest to staging this week.

1) Tenant claim mismatch: When we submitted the publisher identity claim in the portal it flagged a different tenant ID than the one Contoso provided in their SSO proof. Contoso says the correct tenant is 72f988bf-86f1-41af-91ab-2d7cd011db47; portal message shows a provisioning tenant of 72f988bf-86f1-41af-91ab-2d7cd011db48.

- Ask: Is there a canonical place to re-run or refresh the tenant claim so the portal and Contoso's security team align? Any manual correction we should request from your side?

2) SKU stewardship / ownership: We mapped Contoso SKUs in sku-mapping-v2.csv (attached) but the portal requires a single steward email per SKU for co-sell attribution and entitlement mapping. Contoso would like to retain their existing steward but the portal dropdown only lists a different tenant admin.

- Ask: Options to set steward at the SKU level via manifest vs. portal UI? If a portal change is required, what's the expected SLA for that update during offer vetting?

I've attached a draft manifest (manifest-draft.json) and the SKU map. If you need additional identity proofs / signed statements from Contoso, we can push those to you via the publisher-proof-template.docx.

Short timeline: Contoso prefers a staging publish by Friday (2027-04-09) so they can begin co-sell enablement next week.

Thanks — Jordan

--
Jordan Blake
Marketplace Program Manager, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Anita Rao <anita.rao@microsoft.com>

Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Offer initiation: tenant-claim mismatch & SKU stewarding

Hi Jordan / Alex / team,

Thanks for the clear summary and the artifacts — very helpful. A few answers and next steps: 

Tenant claim mismatch:
- Portal sometimes retains a previously-provisioned tenant until a manual refresh is run. We can trigger a tenant-refresh for publisher ID 72f988bf-86f1-41af-91ab-2d7cd011db47 from our side; that will reconcile the provisioning tenant within 1–2 business hours. To be safe, please confirm Contoso's preferred tenant in a signed header or via the publisher-proof-template.docx (I attached a blank template).

SKU stewarding:
- You can declare SKU-level steward_email in the offer manifest (recommended) OR we can update it via the portal. Declaring it in the manifest is preferred for automation and will persist across redeploys. I reviewed sku-mapping-v2.csv and it looks straightforward; the only concern is a SKU id collision with an existing Contoso bundle in their commercial tenant. If that's the case we'll need a short form from Contoso confirming ownership (single paragraph + signature) — use the template and upload it to the shared Drive.

Portal SLA / process:
- If we need to make a manual portal correction (tenant or steward mapping), our onboarding team targets same-day for high-priority publisher requests, otherwise up to 48 hours. For Friday staging, please provide the signed tenant confirmation by EOD today (PST) and flag the request as high-priority in the subject line when you upload.

I've attached the publisher-proof-template.docx and included a link to the internal queue entry we'll use to track this (below). Once you upload the signed proof and confirm the steward_email in the manifest, reply here and I'll kick off the tenant-refresh and queue the portal steward update if needed.

Regards,
Anita
Marketplace Onboarding | Microsoft Commercial Marketplace
anita.rao@microsoft.com

[Attachment: publisher-proof-template.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]
